name: Wingback
description: Wingback AI security — PII, secrets, prompt injection, and policy enforcement for LLM traffic

apiKey.label: Integration API key
apiKey.description: Create a Portkey integration under Wingback → AI Runtime → Gateway → External Gateways and copy the integration API key.

baseUrl.label: Wingback API base URL
baseUrl.description: Production: https://api.wingback.ai. PoC: https://api.wingback.io. Omit to use production.

description.text: Scan LLM inputs and outputs with Wingback realtime detection. Monitor/enforce mode and protection policies are configured in the Wingback console.
Outbound timeout for the Wingback scan call. Default 2500ms. Keep the Portkey hook timeout at 3000ms or higher.
Optional key/value metadata merged into the scan (for example wingback_agent_id for agent containment).
